entities.name: Afrânio da Costa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Afrânio Antônio da Costa was a Brazilian sport shooter who competed in the 1920 Summer Olympics. He served as a judge of the Brazilian Federal Court of Appeals (TFR) between 1947 and 1962. He was born and died in Rio de Janeiro.
